findings.F1: README prerequisites did not name python3 on the host (fixed in README, d77ffeb).
findings.F2: README asks for an existing PBP* reviewer login and did not say how to create one on a new volume.
findings.F2b: Final sufficient set in this installation: PBPReviewer + %DB_USER + a role with only %Service_EmbeddedPython:USE, without %Developer or %All (%Developer was added temporarily in 25 and removed in 29; %Development:USE alone failed in 24). Documented in docs/REVIEWER-SETUP.md (49dfdaa). Not proved minimal.
findings.F2c: A reviewer created after installation must be enrolled in the native Workflow role pbp.Workflow (assign_task_failed otherwise).
findings.F2d: PBP_REVIEWERS is not forwarded by the Compose files; exporting it on the host does nothing (documented, Compose unchanged).
findings.F3: The README called the OCI manifest digest 8fc1e5c6 the image ID; the classic store reports the config 1d3d52bf (fixed, d77ffeb).
findings.F4: passo-09 timed out on the script's fixed 45 s wait. Afterwards passo-12 showed OOMKilled=true while healthy and 3 kernel OOM kills; with 2g, passo-14 passed in 9.178 s. Strong temporal association with the OOM; not a causal proof tied to one specific job.
findings.F5: Original cap 1258291200 B; cgroup peak 1258295296 B (at the cap) under amd64 emulation on Apple Silicon. With 2g (2147483648 B) the later peak was 1956376576 B (about 1.82 GiB). The native x86 main lab showed a 432 MB snapshot peak with zero OOM, but that is not a paired workload or platform comparison. Compose default raised to 2g (45714af), README qualified.
findings.F6: Product robustness: the healthcheck reported healthy while kernel OOM kills had occurred. Candidate wrapper reads oom_kill only when the counter belongs to the container (cgroup v2 with private namespace, or the resolved v1 self path) and reports unavailable otherwise; v1 checked only with fixtures, native checks (94/95) on v2. It is not a worker-liveness probe.
findings.F7: Two separate events: (a) passo-13, after recreation under emulation, the vendor SystemMonitor was in alert and up --wait failed; it later dropped to warn/healthy without reset (consistent with the documented cooldown). (b) passo-93, the candidate failed up --wait because the 60 s start_period expired while PBP init was still running; not attributed to SystemMonitor. start_period raised to 180 s (252638b); passo-95 passed on a new volume.
findings.F8: IPM-OPERATOR step 6 had no concrete command; now documents the production_smoke command and its limits (92de10b, attribution corrected in b0890b6).

path_A: Authored and executed by Codex (97: 55 assertions; 49: 7 additional refusal checks), reviewed by Claude. Claude-authored script 37 was offered and declined by Codex (no new technical doubt); it was not run. Scripted HTTP, not a browser DOM or a human walkthrough.
